comment: DigitalX Solutions Master Facts File. Operational details, platform integrations, and illustrative/client project architectures. Do not list unverified certifications without a proofUrl or hard numeric claims without a source.

company.name: DigitalX Solutions
company.tagline: Custom CRMs and AI automation engineered for Australian and US service businesses.
company.oneLineDescription: DigitalX Solutions is a custom CRM and AI automation consultancy serving Australian and US businesses with custom Next.js portals, AI voice agents, missed-call text-back, GoHighLevel, n8n, and HubSpot workflow systems.

founder.bio: Full-stack automation and CRM architect specializing in custom Next.js and PostgreSQL portals, self-hosted n8n orchestration, GoHighLevel CRM systems, and low-latency AI voice telephony. Jazib leads system architecture and delivery for businesses across Australia and the United States.

technicalLead.bio: Specializes in GoHighLevel multi-location snapshot engineering, bi-directional webhook synchronization, carrier compliance (A2P 10DLC and Australian ACMA SMS standards), and automated lead-routing logic.

partnerCertifications.deploymentScope: End-to-end CRM setups, custom snapshots, two-way SMS/telephony pipelines, and API extensions for multi-location service businesses.
partnerCertifications.deliveryStandard: Documented snapshot configurations, custom webhook actions, and CRM workflows.

partnerCertifications.deploymentScope: Self-hosted and cloud webhook orchestration, legacy database migrations, and API integrations without per-task SaaS markups.
partnerCertifications.deliveryStandard: Documented execution logs with automated error notifications.

partnerCertifications.deploymentScope: Custom object modeling, bi-directional pipeline synchronization, and automated lifecycle reporting.
partnerCertifications.deliveryStandard: Documented REST API endpoints, OAuth 2.0 token handshakes, and field-level validation schemas.

partnerCertifications.deploymentScope: Custom web portals, role-based access control (RBAC), legacy data migration, and automated test pipelines.
partnerCertifications.deliveryStandard: CI/CD pipelines, TypeScript type checking, and full source code repository handover.

tcoModel.calculationInputs: Modeled for a 20-user team over 36 months: Enterprise SaaS seats at $100–$150/user/mo ($72,000–$108,000) + $5,000–$15,000 implementation ($77,000–$123,000+) vs. DigitalX Hybrid Custom CRM build ($8,500–$15,000 fixed scope) + $100–$250/mo cloud/API hosting ($3,600–$9,000) = $12,100–$24,000 (60%+ illustrative savings).

performanceMetrics.typicalLeadLift: 30% - 50% recovered bookings (Illustrative estimate, depends on call volume and follow-up speed)

servicePricingRanges.audExchangeRateNote: AUD pricing approximated at 1 USD ≈ 1.54 AUD (illustrative rate; invoiced in USD or AUD at current bank rate)

clientProjects.calculationInputs: Observed codebase metrics: E-Agent (14 builder portals) plus direct developer portals, 57 of 143 image-only price PDFs handled via RapidOCR and PyMuPDF fallback, 100-point buyer-brief scoring model with 11 hard rejection gates, PropTrack/CoreLogic comparable inputs, and Kommo CRM pipeline sync.
clientProjects.problem: Buyer's agents were manually logging into 14+ builder portals, opening image-only price PDFs, cross-checking suburb comparables in spreadsheets, and copying stock updates into Kommo CRM by hand.
clientProjects.whatWasBuilt: Automated Python property research and benchmarking engine pairing Playwright portal harvesting with RapidOCR/PyMuPDF extraction, a 100-point buyer-brief scoring and risk engine, PropTrack comparable benchmarking, Kommo CRM sync, and interactive HTML/Excel/CSV client reports.
clientProjects.measurableResult: Automated 14+ builder stock feeds, OCR extraction across image-only price lists, and 100-point buyer-brief scoring with interactive HTML and Excel client deliverables.
afterStack: Automated Kommo Sync & HTML Client Reports

clientProjects.calculationInputs: Observed codebase metrics: 20 operational UI modules, 12 Prisma relational models (Tenant, User, Lead, Client, Project, Task, Proposal, Invoice, Activity, TimeLog, AuditLog, WebhookLog, CallRecord), 4 role tiers, and 4 REST ingestion webhook endpoints.
clientProjects.problem: Agencies and service operators accumulate compounding per-seat software fees across disconnected tools for lead pipelines, client retainers, margin calculation, time tracking, e-signature proposals, and webhooks.
clientProjects.whatWasBuilt: Bespoke Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma, and PostgreSQL/Supabase CRM uniting a Command Centre dashboard, AU/US lead pipelines, client health & margin scoring, multi-tenant RBAC, e-signature proposals, Cmd+K global search, audit logging, and live REST webhook endpoints.
clientProjects.measurableResult: Consolidated 20 agency operations, RBAC, margin calculation, and webhook ingestion modules into a zero-per-seat custom CRM platform.
afterStack: RBAC + Audit Log + Cmd+K Global Search

clientProjects.calculationInputs: Observed codebase metrics: 3-tier routing (Supabase Cloud PostgreSQL with RLS -> Django REST Framework API -> resilient local fallback), 8 accredited ISO/IEC 17025 certificate classes, JCGM 100:2008 GUM uncertainty compliance, and legacy VB6/SQL Server schema migration.
clientProjects.problem: Accredited metrology laboratories relied on legacy desktop VB6 database software for equipment catalogs, job contracts, and ISO/IEC 17025 certificate issuance, blocking multi-user cloud access and modern auditability.
clientProjects.whatWasBuilt: Enterprise 3-tier calibration Laboratory Information Management System built with React 19, Vite, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Django REST Framework, and Supabase PostgreSQL RLS covering job orders, proposals, customer directories, liquid charts, and 8 accredited certificate workflows.
clientProjects.measurableResult: Migrated legacy calibration workflows to a cloud-first React 19, Django REST, and Supabase RLS architecture built for ISO/IEC 17025:2017 traceability.
beforeStack: No Row-Level Cloud Security or Failover
afterStack: Supabase Cloud RLS + Django REST Fallback

clientProjects.calculationInputs: Configured for 24/7 after-hours overflow coverage replacing manual voicemail callbacks.
clientProjects.problem: Front desk staff overwhelmed by calls during peak morning check-in rushes, leaving prospective patients on hold.
clientProjects.whatWasBuilt: 24/7 AI voice receptionist trained on dental service menu, hours, emergency triage, and direct PMS calendar synchronization.
clientProjects.measurableResult: Deployed 24/7 AI voice receptionist integrated with practice calendar to answer after-hours patient inquiries without hold queues.

clientProjects.calculationInputs: Missed-call SMS trigger configured for under-60-second carrier dispatch on unanswered inbound rings.
clientProjects.problem: Field technicians on jobsites unable to answer urgent inbound calls, causing after-hours emergency jobs to drop to competitors.
clientProjects.whatWasBuilt: Missed-call text-back within 60 seconds paired with 24/7 AI voice agent triaging emergency repairs and syncing directly to dispatch software.
clientProjects.measurableResult: Deployed GHL automation and instant AI answering for a trade contractor, engaging missed callers via SMS within 60 seconds.

clientProjects.calculationInputs: Multi-step web intake and qualification rules replacing manual phone discovery calls.
clientProjects.problem: Billable advisory hours consumed by manual client intake, repeated phone qualification, and disconnected spreadsheets.
clientProjects.whatWasBuilt: Conversational client intake workflow with automated calendar scheduling and GoHighLevel CRM opportunity pipeline tracking.
clientProjects.measurableResult: Automated multi-step qualification and CRM pipeline intake to reduce manual phone triage for advisory staff.

clientProjects.client: Illustrative CRM Scenario — Trade & Field Services
clientProjects.calculationInputs: Illustrative model: 22 staff seats × $120/mo per-seat SaaS CRM ($2,640/mo × 12 = $31,680/yr modeled seat cost) replaced by a Hybrid Next.js/PostgreSQL CRM; 42,400 modeled legacy contact/CSV rows; ~18 hrs/wk modeled admin entry across 22 team members (~50 min/wk each).
clientProjects.problem: A 22-person field service operator paying ~$2,640/mo in recurring SaaS seat licenses while managing customer records across disconnected spreadsheets and dispatch tools.
clientProjects.whatWasBuilt: Hybrid Custom CRM architecture on Next.js 15 and PostgreSQL with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), E.164 phone deduplication, self-hosted n8n workflows, and GoHighLevel API & Twilio SIP call recording sync.
clientProjects.measurableResult: Illustrative estimate: Up to $31,680/yr SaaS seat fees eliminated, 42,400 modeled records normalized, and ~18 hrs/wk admin entry reduced.

clientProjects.client: Illustrative CRM Scenario — Allied Health Group
clientProjects.calculationInputs: Illustrative model: 4-clinic group paying $1,950/mo enterprise CRM tier × 12 ($23,400/yr modeled software cost); 28,000+ modeled patient profiles across 4 locations; ~14 hrs/wk modeled manual Cliniko re-entry.
clientProjects.problem: A 4-clinic allied health operator locked into $1,950/mo enterprise CRM tiers lacking practitioner-level vs. billing RBAC boundaries or clean Cliniko synchronization.
clientProjects.whatWasBuilt: Proprietary PostgreSQL + Next.js clinician and patient intake portal synced bi-directionally with Cliniko, automated SMS appointment reminders, n8n referral pipelines, and audit-logged RBAC permissions.
clientProjects.measurableResult: Illustrative estimate: ~$23,400/yr modeled CRM overhead avoided, 28,000+ modeled patient profiles deduplicated, and ~14 reception hrs/wk saved.
